title: Family Timeline
shareTitle: Family Timeline — A Growing Story Around the World
description: Put Baby, Toddler, and Now in order, follow family-story stars around a tactile paper globe, and build a private keepsake book with an optional on-device photo.
learningGoals: Sequence personal growth stages from earlier to later
Connect family stories with places on a world map
Build positive self-identity through gentle visual storytelling
interactionModel: forgiving drag or tap-tap timeline placement, assisted tactile globe spin, picture-card choices, and optional local photo import
feedbackModel: correct cards tuck into stitched pockets with spoken time language; mismatches softly return; found stars earn paper stamps and complete a family storybook
